import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Calculate top 10 dog breeds by primary breed
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].dropna().value_counts().head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, orient='h', palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
